intended_object: A type abbreviation, `ℝ × (Space × ℝ)`, for the parameter domain (time, space point, angle variable) on which the library's Euler packet fields live. Inferred from the docstring and from how it is used in `timeDirection`, `angleDirection` and `spatialInjection`.
explanation: The definition only names a product type, ℝ × (Space × ℝ), so the rest of the file can refer to the domain of functions whose jets (value plus Fréchet derivative) are computed. It is a notational convenience for this development, not a mathematical notion with a standard definition in the literature to compare against. So it is an internal technical device.
